property.statement: A Legal vector request is admissible only when the currently selected complete generation's rule/device/dimension and persisted encoder identity match a live inspectable encoder; the reader itself encodes request text, derives and compares identity before and after the normalized call, then queries the corresponding immutable HNSW/index/ID snapshot. A caller-supplied vector or model label is not an authority for vector provenance.
runtime_path: Legal entity/fact/provision rows are projected and embedded by the canonical Legal producer.
The producer persists generation basis, inventory, matrix, HNSW index, and selector under the existing generation-basis owner and Legal v2 projection rule.
LegalKnowledgeStore resolves the selector for each operation and on load reconciles the complete projected table membership and selected HNSW vectors with the matrix.

LegalQueryInput carries query text and the configured local encoder; the shared query gate recomputes actual encoder identity, encodes the text, checks identity drift, and fails before knn_query on mismatch.
LegalKnowledgeGraph exposes entity/fact/provision search and a typed query_profile_error; hybrid search falls back to text when a query profile is unsupported.
property.proxy_divergence: A same-dimension vector from the wrong encoder can rank the decoy when the intake gate is removed, while the admitted text query ranks the target. A model-name match or caller-supplied vector alone would therefore be a proxy for the actual producer identity and encoded request.
negative_controls: Same-dimension wrong live encoder is rejected before HNSW; zero knn calls.
Bypass the gate but keep selected metadata and actual HNSW: the wrong vector retrieves the decoy; restore the gate and the query retrieves the target.
Mutate encoder weights during encode: post-call identity check rejects before HNSW.
Replace the selector during a blocked request: the request stays on its prior snapshot; the next request observes the new generation and rejects the prior encoder.
Previous v1 rule generation is refused; model label/OpenAI key does not authorize remote vectors and hybrid text fallback remains usable.
Independent reviewer reproduced the focused source behavior and reported no additional same-class escape.
